# Anime List

> Anime and manga discovery with advanced filtering, statistics, and optional personal tracking.

## Public pages

- [Anime List — filter 35,000+ anime and manga](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/)
- [Advanced anime search — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/search)
- [Random anime picker — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/random)
- [Anime catalog statistics — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/stats)
- [Advanced manga search — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga)
- [Manga catalog statistics — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/stats)
- [Anime discovery — Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/discover)
- [Anime List changelog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/changelog)
- [Anime List catalog updates](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/catalog-updates)
- [About Anime List](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/about)
- [Anime List privacy](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/privacy)
- [Anime List terms](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/terms)
- [Anime List MCP setup](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/mcp)

## Catalog collections

- Anime detail: https://anime.significanthobbies.com/anime/{malId} and https://anime.significanthobbies.com/anime/{malId}.md
- Manga detail: https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/{malId} and https://anime.significanthobbies.com/manga/{malId}.md

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/api/ai)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- [Sitemap](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Homepage Markdown](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/index.md)

## Developer docs

- [OpenAPI specification](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json): Full API surface description (OpenAPI 3.1)
- [Agent catalog](https://anime.significanthobbies.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public agent surfaces

## CLI

```bash
# Fetch the agent catalog
curl -s https://anime.significanthobbies.com/api/ai | jq .

# Get the OpenAPI spec
curl -s https://anime.significanthobbies.com/openapi.json | jq .

# Fetch the homepage as markdown
curl -s -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://anime.significanthobbies.com/
```
